'''Takashi Teshirogi''' (Japanese: '''てしろぎ たかし''') is the author and manga illustrator born on October 31, 1963 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, Japan. His Pokémon related works is authoring and illustrating the {{pkmn|manga}} series [[Ash & Pikachu]] and adaptations of the movie ''{{OBP|Destiny Deoxys|manga}}'' and the game [[Pokémon Battrio: Aim to be Battrio Master!|Pokémon Battrio]]. His other works include the {{wp|Grander Musashi}} series and is affiliated with [[CoroCoro]], publishing many works in the CoroCoro magazines.
